metadata.document_title: APEX Phase 1 + Phase 2 Verification Evidence Structure
metadata.authority_note: This document is evidence aggregation only. No A.V.I., Governor, or Founder decision is included.

supervisor.blocked_from: Cannot authorize Phase 3 progression without Governor/Founder

avi.role: Verify proof genealogy; document unresolved items; trace authority chain

governor.role: Assess operational continuity risk; approve or hold Phase 3

decomposition.evidence_limitation: Code path verified; functional correctness not independently tested
decomposition.claim: 7 atomic primitives extracted from parent task

routing_decisions.evidence_limitation: Routing logic verified; cost optimization not tested; no A/B testing against alternatives

C1_agent.note: Not routed despite cost advantage for difficulty-1 tasks; QUALITY priority overrides

proof_pack.evidence_limitation: Reproducibility claimed by Event Gate; not independently verified by A.V.I.
proof_pack.efficiency_discrepancy: 5.45 percentage points; metric definition not verified

event_gate.evidence_limitation: 100,000 synthetic test cases on tested paths only; 6 edge cases remain unresolved as HOLD findings

test_coverage.note: Zero mismatches on tested paths; untested edge cases have unknown behavior

memory_assembly.governance_violation: Sealed before Supervisor approval (should seal after approval)

CORR_001_handoff_status.reality: Worker APPROVED; Supervisor PENDING; 4 gates unresolved
CORR_001_handoff_status.correction_applied: Header changed to 'READY FOR SUPERVISOR REVIEW'

CORR_002_memory_seal.violation: mem_5c77f494 sealed at 2026-08-26T01:02:41.321312Z before Supervisor approval
CORR_002_memory_seal.governance_rule: Must seal AFTER Supervisor approval, not before
CORR_002_memory_seal.clearing_action_required: Supervisor authorization for SQL reversion and successor seal

CORR_003_quality_priority.observation: Difficulty-1 tasks routed to B1 ($0.03/1K) instead of C1 ($0.01/1K)
CORR_003_quality_priority.design_decision: QUALITY priority selects capability consistency over cost
CORR_003_quality_priority.authorization_status: Policy application documented but not explicitly authorized by Supervisor
CORR_003_quality_priority.clearing_action_required: Supervisor acknowledgment of QUALITY > Cost priority policy

CORR_004_efficiency_mismatch.evidence_status: Claimed vs. Calculated; no metric definition provided
CORR_004_efficiency_mismatch.clearing_action_required: Supervisor execution logs or definition of efficiency metric

CORR_005_cost_baseline.issue: Reference cost from ungoverned system; baseline not independently verified
CORR_005_cost_baseline.clearing_action_required: Supervisor cost accounting confirmation and baseline definition

CORR_006_overprovisioning.observation: Highest-cost tasks (p5, p6) routed to A1 ($0.15/1K)
CORR_006_overprovisioning.evidence_status: Design intent documented; cost-benefit analysis not provided

event_gate_hold_findings.finding: Identity conflict not enforced at final decision
event_gate_hold_findings.failure_scenario: Duplicate agent IDs accepted in parallel execution
event_gate_hold_findings.affected_claim: All 7 tasks executed successfully without validation errors
event_gate_hold_findings.evidence_required: Code review of identity enforcement; test case demonstrating failure

event_gate_hold_findings.finding: String booleans accepted as boolean (Python bool('false') = True)
event_gate_hold_findings.failure_scenario: Configuration flag 'false' interpreted as True; wrong behavior branch taken
event_gate_hold_findings.affected_claim: Routing decisions applied correctly per configuration
event_gate_hold_findings.evidence_required: Input validation code; test case with string boolean input

event_gate_hold_findings.finding: Non-finite numbers (NaN, Inf) not rejected at input validation
event_gate_hold_findings.failure_scenario: Cost or time inputs accept non-finite floats; routing calculations produce NaN
event_gate_hold_findings.evidence_required: Input sanitization code; test case with non-finite inputs

event_gate_hold_findings.finding: HTTP middleware TVw (transaction validation weight) never populated
event_gate_hold_findings.failure_scenario: Middleware variable remains uninitialized; validation logic uses garbage value
event_gate_hold_findings.evidence_required: Middleware initialization code; traced request flow showing TVw population

event_gate_hold_findings.finding: Readiness (85.0) and truth (95.0) defaults used when HTTP middleware absent
event_gate_hold_findings.failure_scenario: Offline execution paths use default values; metrics artificially inflated
event_gate_hold_findings.evidence_required: Middleware architecture documentation; default configuration approval; load testing results

event_gate_hold_findings.finding: Batch route defaults not measured in production
event_gate_hold_findings.failure_scenario: Batch routing performance degradation undetected; default configuration behavior unknown
event_gate_hold_findings.evidence_required: Production batch routing metrics; load testing showing batch performance

residual_risks.finding: 6 HOLD findings represent untested edge cases
residual_risks.potential_impact: Undetected failure modes in identity validation, input validation, middleware initialization, default value handling
residual_risks.mitigation: A.V.I. verification documents but does not clear; Governor reviews for operational risk tolerance; Founder authorizes Phase 3 acceptance

residual_risks.finding: 5.45 percentage point discrepancy between reported and calculated efficiency; metric definition unclear
residual_risks.potential_impact: Cost-benefit analysis unreliable; true operational efficiency unknown
residual_risks.mitigation: Supervisor clarifies metric definition; provides authoritative efficiency value

residual_risks.finding: $0.91 savings claimed but reference cost not independently validated
residual_risks.potential_impact: Cost savings calculation unreliable; actual savings may differ from claimed
residual_risks.mitigation: Supervisor confirms cost accounting baseline and savings calculation methodology

residual_risks.finding: Memory seal applied before Supervisor approval (CORR-002)
residual_risks.potential_impact: Authority hierarchy compromised; future seal operations may bypass approval gates
residual_risks.mitigation: Supervisor authorizes seal reversion; system enforces post-approval sealing in future operations

residual_risks.finding: No evidence of Supervisor pre-approval recorded before Worker execution
residual_risks.potential_impact: If Constitution requires pre-approval, this represents governance violation
residual_risks.mitigation: Supervisor clarifies whether pre-approval was required; if yes, authorizes predecessor correction record
